summary_en: Terra Co. (owned by Marunouchi Capital Fund III / Mitsubishi Corporation group) to acquire minimum 4,165,800 shares (30.2% S/O) via tender at ¥1,220/share. Tender period 30 business days (Jun 22–Aug 3, 2026). Post-tender acquiror ownership 66.67% (ex-treasury). Delisting intended. Board recommends tender.
title_en: Notice Regarding Implementation of Management Buyout (MBO) and Recommendation for Tender Offer Participation
translation_en_brief: On 19 June 2026, Satudora Holdings announced a management buyout (MBO) via public tender offer by Terra Co., a newly incorporated entity wholly owned by Luna Co. (itself wholly owned by Marunouchi Capital Fund III, an investment vehicle managed by Marunouchi Capital Co., Ltd., a subsidiary of Mitsubishi Corporation). The tender offer aims to acquire a minimum of 4,165,800 shares at ¥1,220 per share, with no upper limit disclosed. The 30-business-day tender period runs from 22 June to 3 August 2026. Upon acquisition of the minimum number, the acquiror's ownership will reach 66.67% (calculated on 13,780,275 shares outstanding ex-treasury as of 15 May 2026). The transaction intends to take the company private and delist it from the TSE Standard and Sapporo exchanges. The board of directors, having confirmed that all non-interested directors (including audit committee members) approved the transaction, endorsed the tender and recommended shareholders to participate. No conflict of interest exists between the company and the acquiror entities.
